name: Pauline Pezza
office: City of West Covina, Member of the City Council, 4th District

items.text: Pauline Pezza says she is a vice president. Her campaign says she has an MBA in finance and has run a small business.

sentences.text: Pauline Pezza says she is a vice president.
Her campaign says she has an MBA in finance and has run a small business.

items.text: Her campaign says she would push for brush clearance and defensible-space enforcement before fire season. She pledges to pursue state and federal grants for street repaving, park maintenance, and safety projects. She promises to respond to every resident request and fix neighborhood problems like playgrounds behind on maintenance. She would work to revitalize District 4 commercial corridors and reduce red tape for small businesses.
